status: source-only operational precommit before collector implementation; no prospective original NOAA observations or trained methods

operator.mode: per-lane bounded local noninteractive once invocation, never daemon or cron installed by code or CI
operator.secret: 256-bit random HMAC key in external OS protected POSIX 0600 file, never repo, standard output, GitHub Actions or committed artifact
operator.signature: HMAC-SHA256 of canonical JSON grant without signature; constant-time verification
operator.approved_capability: exact NOAA GET URL, one lane A or B, fixed R5 schema and Git blob, 10 min, activation UTC and expiry UTC, max 4032 polls, immutable audience and approval id
operator.OS_permission: real activation fails closed on unsupported protected key-file OS custody; Linux POSIX stat owner/mode checked; Windows key custody NOT claimed

journal.storage: per-lane independent SQLite WAL FULL synchronous, rollback guard binds DB to operator grant and original protocol
journal.records: append-only hash chained INTENT, OBSERVED, ERROR, GAP, INTERRUPTED; no overwrite/delete; transaction protected BEGIN IMMEDIATE
journal.timing: slot index from fixed activation at 10-minute UTC alignment, at most 2 minutes late to actually poll; missed slots GAP including recovery
journal.failure: HTTP non-200, 429, invalid JSON, timeout, crash, duplicate/revision and provider errors must preserve explicit bounded error receipt; never create synthetic temperature
journal.data: original response bytes in bounded base64 with SHA and content type; exact receipt and qualified row identities on success
journal.backpressure: max one poll per slot per lane; max body 2 MB; no unbounded replay on restart
journal.corrections: different original rows for same site/hour observed in any independently archived future polls cause CORRECTED_REFUSAL, not rewrite first forecast/target history
journal.gaps: every expected scheduled slot must be present as OBSERVED or typed ERROR/GAP/INTERRUPTED and independently externally anchored; a local record alone is not trusted availability
journal.forbidden: journal alone cannot prove receipt existed before issue; never promote unanchored local capture

external_custody.provider: GitHub Actions original upload-artifact plus externally sourced artifact metadata
external_custody.method: supported actions/download-artifact exact original artifact and separately authenticated GitHub metadata id/run/name/sha256 created_at; direct /zip redirects that returned 401 are not relied on
external_custody.creation_timestamp: GitHub original metadata created_at in UTC must be <= forecast issue UTC for eligible feature; runner timestamps alone untrusted
external_custody.hash: GitHub original ZIP SHA-256 digest must equal external metadata digest; verified record hash and source bytes must match archived original
external_custody.retention_limit: R5 entire 28d and acceptance duration must fall within actual artifact retention; 90d optional retention and external permanent archive later
external_custody.correlated_upstream: same NOAA provider is NOT two independent providers, only two separately timestamped collectors
external_custody.ZIP_safety: bounded ZIP size; safe single filename, no traversal, valid CRC, maximum original JSON bytes

native_tests.qualification_type: synthetic/no network + exact original source-lock and historical negatives
required_negative_cases: same source run for both lanes
native_tests.installation_scheduling: manual only; no scheduled NOAA traffic; no Docker

acceptance.scope: durable host-qualified synthetic source capture and externally authenticated artifact contract, not actual two-lane future collection
acceptance.do_not_claim: production 28d source, global publisher first availability, real live NOAA polling, HDC/KAN improvement, installed MEL authority
acceptance.potential_operating_cost: Two 10-minute lanes for 28 days imply 8064 source polls and potentially 8064 per-poll artifact publications; require approved capacity, artifact retention, runner/time cost and uptime before live activation
acceptance.next: separate operator-approved installation in two actual independent hosts, verify independent third-party anchors and first live capture; then 28 full days and frozen evaluation
